name: a2a-compliance
description: An A2A (agent-to-agent) compliance-control protocol + a loomground-grounded compliance-fleet contract: compliance agents steer maker agents to keep them aligned to the operator's values, over query-state/issue-directive/hold/resume/halt (and report-state/ack/escalate back). Works fully with zero loomground and zero RVND; loomground value-grounding and RVND enforcement are both optional, universal enrichment planes.
